verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Bento records unsubscribe state, since subscribers can be filtered by unsubscribe time (bento-docs-8). A visitor anonymization endpoint supports GDPR-style data deletion (bento-docs-47). Nothing documents automatic suppression or how unsubscribes are honored across send types. Missing for 10: documented automatic suppression of unsubscribes, bounce handling, spam-complaint suppression, enforcement across broadcasts, sequences and transactional sends, and independent corroboration.
